title: 9.7 family — full-metric cross-engine
subtitle: MyVector 9.7 · vsql_vector (VillageSQL 9.7) · pgvector · MariaDB — fashion-mnist-784
nav: ← 8.4 family · real-dataset (MySQL versions) · village (recall/QPS) · cross-engine · MySQL versions
description: The MySQL 9.7 family of the full-metric cross-engine comparison, measured through MyVector's own harness (insert, exact-KNN, ANN p50/p99 all included, unlike the village recall/QPS view). This page is the 9.7 builds of MyVector and VillageSQL's vsql_vector, with pgvector and MariaDB as fixed anchors. The 8.4 family is the companion page.
caveats: Full metrics via MyVector's harness: index build, insert QPS, exact brute-force KNN (QPS + p50/p99), ANN (QPS + p50/p99), recall@10 vs the dataset's published ground truth.

Dataset: fashion-mnist-784-euclidean (60k train × 784-d, 10k test, L2). HNSW M=16, ef_construction=200 for MyVector/vsql_vector/pgvector; MariaDB's MHNSW fixes ef_construction at 10 internally. MariaDB also floors mhnsw_ef_search to ~2×M (≈32), so an ef_search=10 request is not a valid operating point for it (it mis-measures low — QPS below the ef=20 point despite less work); that point is omitted from MariaDB's plotted curve (measured value kept in the result JSON under ef_search_excluded). Every other engine applies no such floor, so their ef_search=10 points are plotted as-is.

Family = MySQL base: MyVector 9.7 = the component on stock MySQL 9.7; vsql_vector (9.7) = the VillageSQL extension on the VillageSQL 9.7 dev-server. pgvector (Postgres) and MariaDB are engine-fixed and appear in both family pages.

Cache parity: each engine's graph sized above the ~188 MB index (MyVector in-memory HNSW + 2 GB InnoDB pool; vsql 2 GB InnoDB pool; pgvector shared_buffers 2 GB; MariaDB mhnsw_max_cache_size 1 GiB). Headline cards are the warm ef_search=200 point.
Hardware: all engines on the same Ampere A1 dev host. MyVector 9.7 and MariaDB are reused from the real-dataset run (same host/dataset/params).
